name: Dick Castle
source:
Supposedly wanted to attend his father's alma mater, Red Mountain State, but the school had since been shut down. Came as a walk-on to Texas A&N and shocked the many who had never heard the name Castle.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

Thad is the son of the famous linebacker who attended the now-defunct BMS. Very much taking after his father, Thad is known for his off-field antics and use of rabies.
